scripts.build:libs: ng build auth-lib --configuration development && ng build shared-lib --configuration development && ng build ui-lib --configuration development
scripts.watch:libs: concurrently -n auth,shared,ui -c cyan,yellow,magenta "npm run watch:auth-lib" "npm run watch:shared-lib" "npm run watch:ui-lib"
scripts.serve:apps: concurrently -n shell,product,order,report -c blue,green,red,orange "npm run serve:shell" "npm run serve:product" "npm run serve:order" "npm run serve:report"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n auth,shared,ui,shell,product,order,report -c cyan,yellow,magenta,blue,green,red,orange "npm run watch:auth-lib" "npm run watch:shared-lib" "npm run watch:ui-lib" "npm run serve:shell" "npm run serve:product" "npm run serve:order" "npm run serve:report"
scripts.dev:shell: concurrently -n auth,shared,ui,shell -c cyan,yellow,magenta,blue "npm run watch:auth-lib" "npm run watch:shared-lib" "npm run watch:ui-lib" "npm run serve:shell"
scripts.dev:product: concurrently -n auth,shared,ui,product -c cyan,yellow,magenta,green "npm run watch:auth-lib" "npm run watch:shared-lib" "npm run watch:ui-lib" "npm run serve:product"
scripts.dev:order: concurrently -n auth,shared,ui,order -c cyan,yellow,magenta,red "npm run watch:auth-lib" "npm run watch:shared-lib" "npm run watch:ui-lib" "npm run serve:order"
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && ng build shell
scripts.build:all: npm run build:libs && ng build shell --configuration production && ng build product-app --configuration production && ng build order-app --configuration production && ng build report-app --configuration production
